- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Layout Pick Friend Redesign: Redesign the character pick screen using a spotlight layout to highlight pet choices one at a time. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a high mean time of 1017s; a spotlight layout helps users focus on pet selection without overwhelming choice clutter.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Shortcuts Welcome Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right before the final welcome screen explaining desktop shortcut controls and right-click actions for the pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Story Intro Redesign: Switches the story intro screen layout to a clean card format highlighting key companion traits. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s; presenting story information in structured cards helps users process path options faster.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Live Pet Preview Adoption Certificate Flow: Adds an interactive live pet preview component directly into the adoption certificate screen so users verify pet appearance before finalizing. (why: Support emails reported custom pet rendering issues and wrong appearances, while adoption dropoff remains high at 39.1%.)
4: [home, new_screen] Pet Care Tips Waiting Screen: Inserts a dedicated pet care guide screen immediately following the loading step to educate users while desktop setup completes. (why: The waiting home step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, during which users drop off or submit support tickets regarding pet interaction.)
5: [finish, redesign] Two Column Home Welcome Redesign: Redesigns the final desktop welcome screen into a side-by-side two column view with pet summary on the left and quick launch on the right. (why: The finish step has a 32% dropoff rate (68.0% conversion); a balanced two-column summary makes final onboarding completion clear.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls Clear Copy Update: Updates the headline and body of the final welcome screen to explain how to interact with and hide the pet on the desktop. (why: Support emails showed multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Alert Toggle: Enables desktop readiness system notifications with an explanatory hint during the pet generation waiting screen. (why: Mean wait time during home setup is 2336s; notifying users when ready prevents user drop-off during long asset loading.)
